canonical_project: Industrial Bank (Xingye) Gui'an New Area Data Center
notes: Located at Machang Industrial New City, Gui'an New Area. Phase 1 main building topped out 2025-08 (China Construction First Group); total investment ~RMB 6.88 bn, ~266 mu, 26.1 wan sqm, planned 18,000 racks supporting 200,000 servers. 2024-11-29 Guiyang Daily reported construction launch. Capacity 108 MW = 18,000 racks x 6 kW (design).
